selected_evidence.requirement: Create an SSH certificate authority and signed host certificate
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the signed host certificate, CA fingerprint, principals, valid sshd configuration, and active HostCertificate setting.

selected_evidence.requirement: Connect without pinning the host key when the client trusts the CA
selected_evidence.summary: A strict client found the CA entry, matched the ED25519-CERT certificate, authenticated, and executed HOST_CERT_TRUST_OK.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 4b7ded33-b5e2-42c9-b7f2-bd671942a82d, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 3ba052ff-8dc8-4fab-bf1e-b3eb857edef1, recovered SSH/certificate state, and a successful post-reboot CA-trusted connection.
